title: Brass Touch+
description: Lite, well optimized Vanilla+ Create experience! Aiming for long term stability and a clean experience.
body:
Lite, well optimized Vanilla+ Create experience! Aiming for long term stability and a clean experience. Aiming to stray away from Feed The Beast style modding.

![Highlighted mods with their icons](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/354a8d6e883608cd0af297a8997154e120f95327.png)

Some highlighted content mods are Create & its add-ons, Farmer's Delight, Supplementaries, Another Furniture, Geophilic, and Explorify. There are _many_ quality of life and visual improvement mods included as well.

![Workshop made with create](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0d630b1c575e5118ef2ca43e7a209ddfab315784.png)

Brass Touch+ expands on Brass Touch to add more content such as create addons, decoration, food, visual overhauls, structures, and much more quality of life. However, Brass Touch+ still aims to stay in line with the original goal of a clean Vanilla+ experience that will try to stay up to date with the latest Minecraft / Create mod releases.

This mod is **_not_** a Feed The Beast style mod pack which reflects its design. There are no backpacks, map GUIs, or jetpacks. Instead, other more Vanilla style features take their place with changes. 

![New bundle recipes](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0e5e1f5a8c1d263757afcf9e27958156f18f76ad_0.webp)
![Shulker box GUI](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/42011b5e049943f6dfe57313bda6e8994dd4d584.png)

Bundles and shulkers are much easier to use and far easier cheaper to craft. You no longer need to sift through bundles or place down shulkers.

![Map atlas](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7630d8948d76be5f71e3c067352735cb9295864d.png)

In-game maps have been heavily buffed, are extremely cheaper, and take zero inventory. This is thanks to Map Atlases and Curio.

![Copper carts](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a9f648941ce9a1c37cb609de1cff1e53431653fb.png)

Minecarts and rails now use copper instead of iron and give you 32 rails (vanilla is 16) or 16 powered rails (vanilla is 6). 

Llamas have also been buffed and horses will likely be buffed in the future as well.

Project is currently in Alpha and quite buggy. There are three "tiers", being Brass Pinch (the lightest), Brass Touch (the standard medium one), and Brass Touch+ (this one). This one is the **heaviest** out of all them but still aims to be lite.
